comparison.objective: Extract a specified terminal; record diagnoses a DC earth fault by sequentially removing and reinserting fuses.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-blade release of a recessed terminal lock versus repeated fuse pull/reinsert actions coupled to meter observation and circuit-state management.
comparison.success_condition: One terminal removed without collateral release or damage versus ending with only the faulty feeder open while avoiding simultaneous loss of multiple circuits. Formal setup and scoring fields are absent; only qualitative/body thresholds are available. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Although both remove electrical components, the record primarily tests instrument-guided sequential diagnosis and reinsertion discipline.
